agency_name: New York City Police Pension Fund
short_title: Bid Extension: Video Surveillance System Replacement
additional_description_1:
The Fund seeks qualified vendors to supply, install, integrate, maintain, and provide training for a comprehensive security-camera system upgrade and expansion at its headquarter located at 233 Broadway, New York and its Disaster Recovery location at 7 Teleport Drive in Staten Island. The objectives of this initiative include:

 

  1. Modernizing and enhancing the Funds physical-security infrastructure by replacing outdated camera hardware.
  2. Expanding video-coverage to critical areas of the facilities.
  3. Integrating the upgraded camera system with existing access-control and building-management systems.
  4. Ensuring interoperability, cybersecurity compliance, and long-term maintainability of the system.

short_title: Laboratory products for rapid and simple wastewater surveillance
additional_description_1:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules, the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH)  intends to enter into negotiations for a 6-year Sole Source agreement with Ceres Nanosciences Inc. to provide NYCs Public Health Laboratory (PHL) with Nanotrap® Microbiome Particles and associated products to enable rapid and simple wastewater surveillance. DOHMH has determined that Ceres Nanosciences Inc. is the sole provider of the required products (particles, buffers, and reagents), as they are solely manufactured and distributed by Ceres Nanosciences Inc.; there are no resellers.

Vendors who believe they can legally provide the required products are invited to submit an Expression of Interest directly to RFI in PassPort- EPIN 81626Y0734, which is due on 9/8/2025 by 2:00 P.M.
 
If you need additional assistance with PassPort, please contact the MOCS Service Desk at https://mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8.
